spans.s:
Aliklava is a kind of carrion bird mentioned in the Atharvaveda.
Foot notes xi. 2, 2; 9, 9. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 88.

Alina is the name of a people mentioned once only in the Rigveda. Roth thought that the Alinas were allies--possibly a subdivision--of the Tṛtsus. Ludwig more probably thinks that they were defeated by sudās, together with the Pakthas, bhalānas, Śivas, and Viṣāṇins, with whom they are mentioned, at the paruṣṇī; and Zimmer suggests that they lived to the north-east of Kafiristan.
Foot notes vii. 18, 7.
Zur Litteratur und Geschichte des Weda, 95; Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 126.
Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 207.
Op. cit., 431. The land is mentioned by Hiouen Thsang.
Alīkayu Vācas-patya is twice mentioned as an authority in the kauṣītaki brāhmaṇa (xxvi. 5; xxviii. 4).
Āligī is the name of a kind of serpent in the Atharvaveda (v. 13, 7). Cf. viligī.
